findings.guideline_ref: Guidelines C(2026) 5054, §6.1.2 para 117; §6.1.1 paras 113-116; §6.1.3 paras 119, 123; §7.1 para 142; §7.2 para 143; Code of Practice, Section 2, Commitment 1, Measures 1.1 and 1.2
findings.message: no perceivable text to inspect for a label — a media endpoint returns an API payload, not the page where the content is shown. Point a 'ui' probe at that page to check this obligation.
findings.title: Delivered content carries a perceivable label disclosing its artificial origin

findings.guideline_ref: Guidelines C(2026) 5054, §4; Code of Practice, Section 1, Commitment 2
findings.message: 1 of 1 asset(s) failed: asset is validly signed but declares algorithmicMedia, not compositeWithTrainedAlgorithmicMedia or trainedAlgorithmicMedia — signed is not the same as marked as AI-generated
findings.title: Delivered media carry a valid manifest marking them as AI-generated
